G1-N1.dataset: CIFAR-10 (canary was MNIST) + CIFAR-100 as OOD; public, lawful

headline: P1R survived independent confirmation on a second real source (CIFAR-100, natural images, 100-class incremental) as same_team_cross_architecture_positive; N1 did NOT survive on CIFAR-10 (confirmation_null). Rigorous methodology yields a differentiated real result: not everything passes.
N1_interpretation: N1 predicted reducible novelty on MNIST (canary positive) but the effect collapsed on CIFAR-10 with the ensemble-correction intervention: incremental 0.406 -> 0.126, group lower-CB 0.036 < SESOI 0.05, architecture agreement 2/3 -> 0/3. The bed was VALID (oracle headroom 0.75), so this is a genuine source-specific null, not an invalid bed. N1 real-data value is MNIST-specific; it does not generalize to natural images under a different intervention.
P1R_interpretation: P1R predicted joint retention-plasticity replay value on split-MNIST (canary positive) AND on CIFAR-100 (confirmation positive, 11/11, group lower-CB 0.053 >= SESOI 0.05, 2/3 capable architectures). The margin is NARROW (0.053 vs 0.05); a genuine but modest pass. Classified same_team_cross_architecture_positive: same-team implementations across 3 capable architectures on a second source, NOT full independent scientific replication (no external published mechanism was used).
